title: A row one lane deletes from docs/debts/notes.md stays deleted when another lane in the same batch appends next to it
why: Lane notes-fix-guard-1 (session_013NEJL3G6vFtN2TjNZrMETW), 13:12 CST Nov 8: under `.gitattributes` merge=union for docs/debts/notes.md, a row one lane deletes comes back when another lane in the same batch appends next to it. Proven in a scratch repo by #1920 round 2 (sonnet): lane A deletes the last note, lane B appends after it, and the integration merge revives the row. `check_silent_undo.py --strict --upstream <base> --head integ` exits 0; it catches a revival only when the deletion is already on main. Decision notes-merge-union's text is being corrected to say so and to cite this step.
note: Sighting (lane push-head-upstream-name, 13:39 CST Nov 8): the union driver brought deleted lines back into #1852 and #2199 today. Sighting (coordinator 14:45 CST Nov 8, from lane mcp-tools-in-guard-matcher): main holds 9 duplicate note keys in docs/debts/notes.md from union merges (for example handoff-unread, opus-plain-ask). #1687 f4fc22ad9 repairs only its own re-added lines. The 9 duplicates on main need a one-time clean-up, owned here. Sighting (coordinator 14:58 CST Nov 8): on #1471 a union-merged notes file revived rows that batch 65 retired, and the silent-undo check refused it. Cause (coordinator 15:00 CST Nov 8, from step silent-undo-merge-base): lint/check_silent_undo.py reads the real merge result (`git merge-tree --write-tree upstream head`). The merge=union driver on docs/debts/notes.md (.gitattributes) brings back a note main deleted (git-rm-cached-false-alarm, deleted by batch 65) when a lane edits the next line: the "union never removes a line one side kept" cost in decision notes-merge-union. The fix belongs at the merge driver or the revival path, not the check. Sighting (lane notes-fix-large-1, session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m, 15:05 CST Nov 8; folded here instead of a new step notes-union-dup-slug, same union-driver cause): #2171's merge-up of #2052 kept both the old and the moved `jq-lone-word-false-alarm:` line, with no git conflict; a fix check caught it. Second time, after #1613. Proposed guard: lane lint fails when one slug opens more than one line of notes.md. Sighting (lane push-head-upstream-name, session_013NEJL1YxsYqim39RK6JeZP, 15:54 CST Nov 8): the union driver brought back deleted note lines four times today; once it restored push-wrong-branch-no-upstream, which #1833 drops, and the silent-undo check caught it. Proposed fix: the driver, or a check that compares the merge result's ids with both parents. Sighting (lane notes-fix-guard-1, #1920, via the coordinator, 16:16 CST Nov 8): main 2ac382cc6 holds 12 more duplicate note slugs (5 ci-coverage-*, 7 touched-tests-*) besides the 9 that #1920 removes. Main's check passes because a lane fails only on duplicates its own diff adds. `check_record_slugs.py --list` on main names them all. Coordinator 17:02 CST Nov 8: #2266 folds into main's revived_notes (lint/check_silent_undo.py). The lane opens one new PR with the leftovers (octopus carry, non-slug rows); #2266 joins the close list on step branch-cleanup. Replacement PR #2339 (draft, head 0657987b4, branch notes-revived-leftovers) holds the octopus carry and non-slug notes; the row-specific trailer stays with #1973. Rounds 1-3 next (lane 17:30 CST Nov 8). Sighting (lane verdict-format-line, session_013NEJL1BCgLVUACYU5ujv9A, Nov 8 18:54 CST by triage's clock; proposed step:notes-union-dup-slug): in the verdict stack on main 2ac382cc6 a union merge (1) brought back note verdict-bare-after-label, which #2093 deletes (1d5f0bdc3; silent-undo caught it by count), and (2) added #2043's older copy of verdict-label-shapes-probe beside #2093/#2109's in-place edit (5207caf2d, 568263cf9; silent-undo missed it, a Sonnet fix check caught it). Proposed guard: lint/check_silent_undo.py refuses a head where a note slug appears more times than on the merge base or main, unless a Drops-lines style trailer names it; main already holds 22 duplicate slugs, so it compares counts.
